findings.fix: Delete both declarations; callers use `TauCeti.Algebra.mul_mem_wordFiltrationPrevious_left (ι Q) hx hy` and `..._right (ι Q) hx hy`, exactly as the new `AssociatedGraded.lean` does at lines 147 and 161.
findings.issue: `mul_mem_filtrationPrevious_left` (:187) and `mul_mem_filtrationPrevious_right` (:193) now state their hypotheses and conclusions entirely in the generic vocabulary (`wordFiltrationPrevious (ι Q)`), and with `filtration` changed to an `abbrev` (:114) they are literally `TauCeti.Algebra.mul_mem_wordFiltrationPrevious_left/right (ι Q)` up to reducible unfolding. Their only consumers were `filtrationGradedPreMul_mem_ker_left/right` in the file this PR deletes, so they now have zero uses; their names also refer to `filtrationPrevious`, deleted in this same PR.

Replacement at `TauCeti/Algebra/WordFiltration/Basic.lean:201`; the PR rewrote the analogous `filtration_zero`/`filtration_one` call sites to `wordFiltration_zero` (Filtration.lean:582) and `wordFiltration_one` (Vectors.lean:260).

findings.issue: `one_mem_filtration` is a one-line restatement of `TauCeti.Algebra.one_mem_wordFiltration (ι Q)` and, after the deletion of `TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/CliffordAlgebra/AssociatedGraded.lean` (which used it as `one_mem_filtration Q 0`), has no consumer left. This is the same situation as `filtration_zero`/`filtration_one`, which this PR does delete in favour of `wordFiltration_zero`/`wordFiltration_one`; the cleanup was applied selectively.

summary: Generalizing the Clifford associated graded to word filtrations is genuine deduplication, and Mathlib has no associated-graded API to reuse. But the PR orphans three Clifford wrappers whose last consumers were the deleted file, and after `filtration` became an `abbrev` two of them are now the generic lemmas verbatim, named after a definition this PR deletes.
